name: styles
description: Design-system extractor and style manager for AI coding agents: extract tokens from URLs or CSS files, transform to shadcn/Tailwind/CSS-vars/MUI/Radix formats, audit color contrast, and manage style profiles, templates and kits. Ships the `styles` CLI, a `styles-mcp` server, and the package SDK. A local dashboard server runs via `bun run server` (no shipped bin), binds 127.0.0.1 by default on a free port above 7200, serves the built dashboard plus unauthenticated /api/* routes, and reads a local SQLite store at ~/.hasna/styles/styles.db. The data backend is the only runtime switch.

serviceSurfaces.name: styles-dashboard-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The HTTP API ships but is not a supported service surface: it runs only via `bun run server` (package.json declares no styles-serve bin), binds 127.0.0.1 by default on a free port above 7200, and is unauthenticated. It serves the built dashboard plus /api/* routes with no GET /health, no GET /ready, no GET /version and no /openapi.json, so it does not meet the v1 service topology. Binding it to a non-loopback host (STYLES_SERVER_HOST) exposes the store unauthenticated.

waivedStorageEngines.reason: PostgreSQL is not implemented at runtime: src/lib/pg-migrations.ts holds a translated schema but no code path reads a DATABASE_URL or selects a PostgreSQL store; server and client both use the SQLite store at ~/.hasna/styles/styles.db.
